items.name: sum_div_nat_floor_pow_sq_le_div_sq
items.type: (N : ℕ) {j : ℝ} (hj : 0 < j) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 < c) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N with j < ↑⌊c ^ i⌋₊, 1 / ↑⌊c ^ i⌋₊ ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 5 * (c - 1)⁻¹ ^ 3 / j ^ 2

items.name: Chebyshev.primeCounting_sub_theta_div_log_isBigO
items.type: : (fun x => ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting - Chebyshev.theta x / Real.log x) =O[Filter.atTop] fun x => x / Real.log x ^ 2

items.name: Chebyshev.primeCounting_eq_theta_div_log_add_integral
items.type: {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting = Chebyshev.theta x / Real.log x + ∫ (t : ℝ) in 2..x, Chebyshev.theta t / (t * Real.log t ^ 2)
